title: Exact Real Chamber Spectra of Explicit Keller Maps
summary: Realizes every parity-compatible fiber count on the open locus C != 0 with squarefree inverse polynomial, using one explicit rational Keller map in each degree.
verification: Revised fold statement, explicit polynomial divisibility and chain-rule Jacobian proof; fresh LaTeX build and visual PDF inspection; selected exact seed and chamber controls, not an all-degree computational proof.
next_steps: Obtain an external novelty comparison for the chamber spectrum and adjacency statement.
Decide whether to release this as a standalone companion note.
abstract:
Migus classified the generic degrees of real polynomial Keller maps with
non-dense Euclidean image: in every dimension at least three they are exactly
the even integers at least four.  We refine the realization side inside one
explicit weighted family.  For every \(N\geq3\) we give a rational Keller map
\(F_N:\A^3\to\A^3\) of generic degree \(N\).  On the open target locus
where the last coordinate is nonzero and the scalar inverse polynomial is
squarefree, its real fibers have exactly
\[
  N,N-2,N-4,\ldots,N\bmod 2
\]
points, and no other cardinalities.  Every value occurs on a nonempty open
target chamber, every chamber contains a rational target, and selected
chambers with the displayed cardinalities form a chain whose successive
walls are smooth folds of the inverse polynomial pencil.  In even degree the
last chamber is disjoint from the image, recovering the non-dense examples
in Migus's classification with their full real sheet spectrum.
